description: Authoritative approved live-trading window for the graded DCA task (ce16ba6b). Weekdays in [start_date, end_date] inclusive are the approved_test_dates; outside them run_once date gates block all execution. decision_time_et aligns the strategy decision anchor with ce16ba6b's authoritative 3:30 PM ET (15:30) run time; change it if the live run time changes. end_date extended 2026-09-18 from 2026-10-30 to 2027-03-12 to span the full Eastern standard-time season: the external Perplexity backup trigger gates are now DST/EST-aware (dual-hour UTC crons covering both the EDT-hour and EST-hour local fires, verified 2026-09-18), which was the prior blocking condition noted in the 2026-07-26 extension. 2027-03-12 (a Friday) is the last trading day before the 2027-03-14 EST->EDT transition, which falls on a Sunday; weekdays_only is true, so a Saturday end_date could never be an approved date and would permanently break the APPROVED_TEST_DATES parity invariant. Extend again before then if needed. Originally scoped to the morning (42173154), midday (a6239dae), and afternoon (10ce362c) live tasks whose in-repo executors load this file directly; extended 2026-07-27 (Codex review, P1: 'Gate the new live schedules by the approved trading window') to also bind the market-open (2ba19526) and intraday (7be82b97) live tasks, which have no in-repo executor and so must have this same window applied by the external scheduler per their own approved_trading_window manifest blocks in config/scheduled_tasks.json.
